title: Chapter 328
text:
The interface of [Faction Management] was the most complicated one among all the NPC templates. There were many options, and he could do all the functions of a normal faction, such as faction relationship, contribution points, and finally issue faction missions. However, there was a limit to these functions.

The reward limit for an individual mission was determined by one's level, grade, faction relationship, and Legendary Points. However, the faction limit was an independent system with six factors.

Faction Reward Limit: 92000

Leader Level: Lv.70: + 56000

Officers: None (NPC)

-47 Players: + 20000

-2 Renown: + 4000

Legendary Points: Leader (3) + 15%

Allies or Enemies: None

The faction limit was used to issue faction missions. 92000 was the maximum limit for a single mission, and the daily limit was twenty times, which was much higher than the five times for an individual. Furthermore, officers, Legendary Points, and Renown would increase the daily limit. Currently, his Renown was too low, so it was not shown. However, as the leader, Han Xiao's three Legendary Points had increased by six times, which was equivalent to two times of one point. The daily limit was twenty-six times for now.

Twenty-six times meant that he could give 2,400,000 EXP to players in the same faction every day. However, if he split it evenly among more than fifty people, each person would only get 50,000 EXP per day, which was obviously not enough for players of this level.

The limit mainly limits the scale and expansion speed. This is just the newly established limit, so there is still a lot of potential for growth. Han Xiao was very confident.

He analyzed the points one by one. First, there was no need to talk about the leader level. The stronger he was, the higher the limit. Officers had to be NPCs, and if NPCs of different levels joined the faction, it would increase the limit. This made Han Xiao even more determined to get in touch with protagonists. The scale would count the players, and the increase would be similar to energy level. When the number of players reached a certain standard, the next limit would be increased. For example, the next limit would be a scale of one hundred people. Fame was different. It was the same as the Reputation System, but there was a small difference. The Fame of a faction was the sum of the Reputation in all regions. For example, the Garton Star System had 10 points of Fame, and the Gelock Star Cluster had 5 points. Adding up to 15 points, that was the sum of the faction's Fame.

Legendary Points had a percentage increase to the limit, and the benefits were very high. Furthermore, it was not only the leader who had Legendary Points, which would also increase the limit. Therefore, the benefits of recruiting NPCs were very high. Finally, there was "allies and enemies". This was the relationship between one's own camp and other camps. It was equivalent to diplomacy.

Apart from faction quests, it could also manage the players' faction relationships, contribution points, and so on. Han Xiao was extremely satisfied with this function. A lot of data could be seen at a glance, and there were more ways to attract players through the interface.

When Han Xiao's faction was created, the players also received a notification on the interface.

You have joined [Black Star Mercenary]. Current Relationship: Cold (0/300)

The players were used to it. To them, it was normal for a faction notification to appear.

A player's name appeared in Han Xiao's faction management list. His eyes flashed as he sent a notification to the player.

You are part of the first batch of Black Star Mercenary members. + 300 Contribution. Current Relationship: Neutral (300/1000)

"There are such benefits?"

"Our relationship is now neutral."

The players were pleasantly surprised. They hurriedly looked at the faction interface. Faction relationships were also contribution points that could be used to exchange for rewards. They wanted to see what the Black Star Mercenary could exchange for.

As soon as they entered the faction reward interface, a dazzling array of items appeared. Many of them were items that were sold in Han Xiao's own shop. He had transplanted them into the faction reward interface. Furthermore, he had also put in some good items that were not for sale. For example, the 2.5 Ranger required 1,500 contribution points, the Small Collapsible Battery required 1,200 contribution points, and the first version of the Viper Mechanical Suit required 6,000 contribution points.

These items were equivalent to drawing a pie in the sky. They had been used many times, but they were always effective.

"Good stuff!"

"Godly equipment!"

The players were instantly excited. These items could not be bought. The first time they appeared in front of the players, the effect was very shocking.

"The mercenary group has just been established," Han Xiao said. "Our Credibility Points are still very low. Only by increasing our Credibility Points can we accept missions with higher rewards. We are now partners. The future of the mercenary group depends on everyone's hard work."

Then, he showed the players the size of the faction on the faction interface, indicating that the growth of the faction would increase the mission rewards. He did this to let the players understand that their own contributions could promote the growth of the faction, and it was closely related to the amount of rewards they would receive to increase the sense of immersion of the players.

Such a series of punches made the players dizzy.

Then, Han Xiao turned to look for Sunil's employment applications. For the sake of his subclass, he decided to be the first to accept Sunil's missions. Very soon, he found a few missions, but the recruitment requirements were at least 120 Credibility Points.

"120 points?" Han Xiao stroked his chin. If he had followed the normal route, he would have been able to accumulate 120 points by doing a few combat missions. However, he decided to do those missions that required at least one Credibility Point. Daily missions were safe and easy, but they were more time-consuming. However, the players were all ready-made, so it would be a waste not to use them.

He immediately used the new function to write a faction mission for the players.

Faction Mission [Credibility Criteria]

Mission Introduction: The Black Star Mercenary has decided to accept a mission, but it does not meet the Credibility Criteria. You need to increase your Credibility Points. (Note: This is the prerequisite mission for the first mission.)

Mission Requirements: Accept the daily mission in the Hub Hall and achieve 120 Credibility Points for the Black Star Mercenary.

Reward: 45,000 EXP, 300 Faction Contribution Points.

Note: The top three Credibility Contribution Points will receive additional rewards.

"The EXP is quite little, but the Faction Contribution Points are quite good."

"Didn't you see? This is the prerequisite mission. After completing it, there will be combat missions. That's a lot of EXP."

"This is a group mission, right? It requires everyone to contribute 120 Credibility Points."

"Yo, the top three Credibility Contribution Points will receive additional rewards."

Everyone whispered to each other. Seeing the additional rewards, Mad Blade and Hao Tian were eager to try. They knew better than anyone else that Han Xiao's additional rewards would definitely be good stuff.

The mission only required them to do daily missions in the Hub, which would only give them at least one Credibility Point. They were all cleaning, logistics, and maintenance jobs. The good thing was that they would not leave Juberly Hub. With more than fifty players working together, they would accumulate Credibility Points very quickly. Han Xiao was not worried at all. Furthermore, the mission itself would also give the players rewards. Together with the Faction Mission, this was a double reward. If the players joined his faction, there would be almost nothing but benefits, so there was no reason to reject it.

With Han Xiao's approval, the players dispersed and went to accept the daily missions. With such a group of assistants, Han Xiao could do other things without wasting time on daily missions. He returned to the resting room and prepared to perfect his plan.

A few hours later, Li Ge and the others returned to the resting room. They had been wandering outside for a few hours. Li Ge thought that since they were in the galaxy, they had to activate missions as soon as possible. There were so many people in the Hub hall, so he thought that there would be many missions that he could activate. However, he realized that most of the people there were just passing travelers. When they expressed that they wanted to help, eighty percent of the people there would laugh at them for not going to the Mercenary Alliance.

Although they did not receive any missions, Li Ge and the others received new information. They asked for directions and found the Mercenary Alliance. After working for half a day, they finally registered as mercenaries. Seeing the mission list, they were overjoyed. They felt that they had found the right way to accept missions in the galaxy.

Li Ge believed that acting alone was the right thing to do, so he was ahead of the other players.

The few of them chatted as they walked in.

"This time, we've gotten the upper hand. Should we tell the others about the mercenary qualifications?"

Li Ge shook his head. "This is an opportunity that we found. We're all competitors. There's no need to tell them."

"Then, if they ask, do we have to keep it a secret?"

Li Ge thought about it, and his expression became troubled. If others asked and he purposely hid it, he would easily offend them. Just as they were hesitating, they opened the door and found that there was not a single player in the resting room.

"Huh, where did they all go?" A Temple of God player was confused.
